summary: Prefer foreground writer loans over explicitly queued background pages with bounded background progress

schema.detail: In-memory scheduling only; no database changes.

rules.detail: Admission, authority, transaction rollback and durable acknowledgements are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: New explicit write_background API on the existing writer. Existing foreground write and batched callers retain FIFO ordering; hook installation remains an all-prior-work barrier.

downtime.detail: No consumer switches to background classification in this library change.

manual.detail: Background owners opt in only for bounded pages, release between pages and revalidate source and authority after acquisition.

recovery.detail: No active holder is preempted. Cancelled borrowers release the connection and failed transactions retain existing rollback behavior.
